core_obligations: Statement (lines 1419-1427): Q proves forall x (x < num(n+1) -> x = 0 or ... or x = num n).
Base case n = 0 (proof lines 1429-1445): from a < num 1 unfold the < definition, split on axiom Q_3, and drive the successor case through Q_5, Q_1 to c < 0, contradicting the less-zero stub.

Inductive step (lines 1445-1458): from a < num(n+2), axiom Q_3 splits; the successor case chains Q_8, Q_5, Q_1 to b < num(n+1) and applies the induction hypothesis, then lifts numerals by successor and substitutes a = b'.
proof_roadmap: Run the base case through the < definition, Q_3 split and the Q_5/Q_1/Q_8 chain.
Run the inductive step with the same axioms, landing in the induction hypothesis.
Lift the disjunction through the successor and substitute back.
difficulty_reason: Bounded-numeral coverage (statement 1419-1427, proof 1429-1458): base and induction step both carried as explicit axiom chains (Q_1, Q_3, Q_5, Q_8) with the less-zero stub closing the contradiction. H3.
